name: cobol-oo-unit-routing-limits
body: oo_unit routes a CLASS-ID or INTERFACE-ID at a header position, but a bare CLASS-ID inside a program's DATA or PROCEDURE section is absorbed into that section because section ends do not stop at unit headers, and an INTERFACE-ID nested in a program is skipped with a diagnostic because Program has no interfaces field. Limit: such nested units yield no facts. Upgrade by threading the dialect into the section-end check and giving Program an interfaces field when real COBOL 2002 sources nest them.
